name: Superpowers
summary: Agentic software development methodology: composable skills for brainstorming, planning, TDD, review and subagent execution.
description: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for coding agents, installed as composable skills that trigger automatically. An agent brainstorms a spec with you, writes a plan, implements tasks through subagents with two-stage review, follows strict red/green TDD, and finishes the branch. Its skills library covers brainstorming, writing-plans, test-driven-development, systematic-debugging, code review and worktrees; it installs into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Kimi Code, Antigravity and others.
contains: 14 skills including brainstorming, writing-plans, test-driven-development and subagent-driven-development
installs via plugin marketplaces for 14 coding agents
commercial support available from Prime Radiant
